terms.gloss: a sign of what is to come, a foreboding, an omen
evidence: Cic. Div. 1.102: hominum, quae vocant ōmina (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Phil. 9.9: ut ejus ōrātiō ōmen fātī vidērētur (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: quī discēdēns mēcum ita locūtus est, ut ejus ōrātiō ōmen fātī vidērētur
phrases.english: who, as he left, spoke with me in such a way that his words seemed an omen of his fate

sources: Lewis & Short: omen
